name: notes_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

itemId.description: Id of the work item that owns the note: a full UUID or 8 to 32 hex characters of one.

key.description: Note key, unique per item (1 to 200 characters, case-sensitive). [select: get]

ifVersion.description: The version the caller already holds (at least 1). When it equals the current version the answer is {unchanged: true, version} with no body. [select: get]

role.description: Only notes of this role: queue, work or review (case-insensitive). [select: list]

keys.description: Only notes with one of these keys. An empty list matches nothing. [select: list]

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's page.next. [select: list]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Read the notes on work items: get one note with its body, or list an item's notes without bodies. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
